lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in a regular geometric grid of approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns along the lateral mid-section posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity coincide with the vertical columns of the circular clusters, creating nodal intersections across the flank where the bands cross the horizontal rows of spots.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three linear features run parallel to the dorsal midline, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a dark lower edge, extending from the posterior head region toward the caudal fin.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately seven small, high-luminance blobs are sparsely distributed across the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin, mainly concentrated in the lower half and posterior margin of the fin mask.

other_distinctive_markers: Three elongated dark silhouettes with distinct fin-like protrusions are visible in the surrounding water: one adjacent to the pectoral fin, one near the mid-ventral line, and one posterior to the pelvic fin. The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of small-diameter bright pixels.
